titles.ja: りゅうおうのおしごと!
titles.en: The Ryuo`s Work Is Never Done!

title.ja: 押しかけ弟子

1.overview: Ai Hinazuru of JS (elementary school girl) rushed to the house of a 16-year-old boy, Kuzuryu Yaichi, who became the best title in the shogi world, "Ryuo", at the age of 9 who admires him as a "master"! ?? At first, he thought he would turn back, but Yaichi, who felt a glimpse of his talent, decided to welcome her as an uchi-deshi for the time being, partly due to the progress of Master Kiyotaki. In this way, the story of Ryuo Kuzuryu Yaichi and his disciple Ai Hinazuru began.
1.summary:
Kuzuryu Yaichi is history`s youngest shougi player to take the title of Ryuo. However, in midst of his slump, a girl named Hinatsuru Ai suddenly appears!?
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 弟子のいる日常

2.overview: At the Shogi Hall, where Yaichi took me, I became acquainted with JS named Mio Mizukoshi, Abe no Sadato, and Charlotte Isoar. Around the same time, Yaichi, who was playing in the official game, was in danger of falling into the trap of Ayumu Kaminabe 6th Dan. Ayumu's dragon-killing Georgius-that is, the "lancer" approaches the dragon king Yaichi. Beside that, Ai was staring at the board with a serious expression ....
2.summary:
While Ai is at the workshop making new friends, Yaichi struggles during his Imperial title match against Ayumu. How will Yaichi overcome this challenge?
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 研修会試験
title.fr: Le test du club de shogi

3.overview: Ai will take the entrance examination of the workshop. Moreover, if you do not clear the condition of winning all the exams given by your parents, you will not be able to continue playing shogi. After defeating Abe no Sadato of the same JS Lab and Yoshitsune Kuruno, a professional shogi player, the final game is finally over. What stood in front of Ai was Yaichi's sister and apprentice, Sora Ginko, the strongest woman with the nickname "Snow White of Naniwa." Ginko's relentless hands hunt down her childhood. Can Ai win? ??
3.summary:
Ai`s parents show up to bring their only daughter back home, but decides to allow Ai to continue playing shogi as Yaichi`s disciple under one condition — if she wins all her three matches during her entrance exam.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: もう一人のあい

4.overview: At the request of Kudan, the chairman of the Shogi Federation, Yaichi met Yasha Shinteni, a selfish young lady in the 4th grade of elementary school. Although it is a twisted and high-flying garment, the skill of shogi is quite good. Yaichi, who thought that the existence of his rivals would strengthen his relationship, secretly decided to welcome Tengi as a disciple. Yaichi trains his garment at the Shogi Dojo in the New World, refraining from being in a bad mood when he takes another disciple. Of course, Ai couldn't have noticed such a suspicious master ...
4.summary:
The life of Yaichi and Ai begins, filled with shogi and learning. That is until one day, he`s called in by the president of Kansai Shogi Association, Tsukimitsu Seiichi.
Source: Crunchyroll

title.ja: 天衣無縫

5.overview: Yaichi unfortunately found the site where he was secretly practicing his garment. Ai was furious that she was lying and "practicing" with a "cute" girl of the same age. Due to the provocation of Tengi and Yaichi's rant, Ai "gets out" and stays in Master Kiyotaki's house. Yaichi goes to bring Ai back, but the words of the master who understands all the circumstances of the matter decide to keep Ai at the master's house for a while. After learning the practice at the shogi dojo in the town, Tengi decided to take the entrance examination for the workshop.
5.summary:
When Ai finds out about the other Ai, the relationship between Yaichi and Ai takes a toll. How will Yaichi navigate through this in order to prove that he`s thinking of the best with her in mind?
Source: Crunchyroll

title.ja: オールラウンダー

6.overview: Yaichi's natural enemy is Yaichi Yamato, who is an all-rounder and has the nickname of "both swordsmen." Yaichi asks General Ikuishi Mitsuru, who has the nickname of "Maestro", to teach him and aim to become the same all-rounder before the rematch with him, who was defeated in the game after a long absence and is about to come three weeks later. Yaichi and Ai go to the public bath and dojo "Gokigen no Yu" run by Ikishi every day to practice. Not only to win the sword cutting, but also to prepare for the battle with the master who was called the strongest genius in history.
6.summary:
Yaichi loses yet again to Natagiri Jin, an all-rounder player. It`s not only Ai who is learning and growing — Yaichi is too.
Source: Crunchyroll

title.ja: 十才のわたしへ

7.overview: Yaichi did not give up the game with the natural enemy, Yamatobuki Hachidan until the end, and Yaichi showed a come-from-behind victory. However, its appearance is too dazzling for Katsura today. Born in a shogi player's family as the daughter of Kiyotaki Kudan, she has been familiar with shogi since she was a child, and as the age limit of the workshop approaches, she has not yet been qualified to become a female shogi player. Katsura, who loses her confidence and suffers, suddenly stops at an old research notebook she once wrote. There ...
7.summary:
How does Yaichi challenge Natagiri and Meijin`s perfect research that predicts his loss? In the meantime, Keika makes up her mind...
Source: Crunchyroll

title.ja: はじめての大会

8.overview: Ai and Tengi participated in the challenge match of the biggest competition in the women's shogi world, "My Navi Women's Open", along with Katsura. The two have won four consecutive victories. Yaichi felt a little loneliness with joy in the grown-up appearance of his disciples. The next day, Yaichi, who was invited to the shogi broadcast, was in charge of commentary with a female shogi player, Tamaki Kajiba. However, when he was furious at the flirtatious appearance, he broke into the studio with JS Lab. Rumors of suspicion of Ryuo Lolicon all over the country due to a series of misleading problem statements ...! ??
8.summary:
Both Ai`s are having their first official matches in Mynavi Female Open! But it`s not just them who are fighting and growing.
Source: Crunchyroll

title.ja: 八月一日

9.overview: My Navi Women's Open Qualifying. Aito, who has enough energy, won the first round. The next opponent Ai will play against is the title holder of the female throne, "Ikazuchi of the Handling", the sacred thunder. Thunder is obsessed with Yaichi and asks for a reply to his confession. Yaichi cannot imagine the future in which Ai will win due to the difference in ability between Thunder and Ai, but on the other hand, Ai vowed that he would never lose today for some reason. Can Ai break the thunder! ??
9.summary:
August 1st — the preliminary round for the Mynavi Female Open starts! Both Ai`s can`t afford to lose, but a giant wall stands in front of Ai...
Source: Crunchyroll

title.ja: スピニングドラゴン

10.overview: An absolute god-like champion and master with six titles of eternal qualifications. The Ryuo battle will be held in which the master will "challenge" the current Ryuo Yaichi. The venue for the first station is Hawaii, an island of everlasting summer. At the resort-like eve, Ai's 10th birthday is also celebrated, and innocent comments asking her to win are praised. And the first station that was greeted. The master sets up an unexpected "one-handed loss angle replacement" in Yaichi. Yaichi, who is familiar with this tactic, seemed to have an advantage in the situation ...
10.summary:
Yaichi vs. Meijin — the Ryuo title match begins. The player who wins four rounds first out of seven takes the title. What will happen to Yaichi?
Source: Crunchyroll

title.ja: 寿

11.overview: After finishing the third station of the Ryuo War, Yaichi is impatient because he can't even reward his masters. I can't afford to think about the fact that I fell down with a fever. He refused even Ginko's best advice. Every day I'm lonely, staying in my room and immersing myself in my research. Hoping for Yaichi's revival, Katsura leaves a note asking him to watch his game. The next Mynavi main race is a big chance for Katsura to become a female shogi player. What does she want to tell Yaichi through the game?
11.summary:
Ai collapses after her match while Yaichi isolates himself from everyone. Keika is also one victory away from making her dream come true.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 最後の審判

12.overview: The 4th station of the Ryuo battle between the master and Yaichi, which is held at the hot spring inn Hinatsuru. If he loses here, Yaichi loses the title of Ryuo. But his heart was calm and clear. Aito, Ginko, and Katsura watch the biggest battle in Shogi history in the waiting room. And Tengi watching the online broadcast from home. No one knows the whereabouts of the game. Supported by the eyes of Ai who believes in the victory of the master, Yaichi challenges the fateful battle! !!
12.summary:
It`s the fourth round of the Ryuo title match. If Yaichi doesn`t win this round, he will lose his Ryuo title.
Source: crunchyroll
